about: Gate 21 drives each ply-25 refutation line it names (block D: Bxe7 Bxd7+, Bxe7 Rd1, Kxe7 Bxd7, Kxe7 Qa3+, and a quiet-middle Bxe7 a6 Bxd7 forced into the engine's answer) and checks the engine's own line by the rule (N11). Graded: the TC-R229 lines and N10, in the gate's own situations - the natural line, and each driven line. The whole gate runs, about 6 minutes a try. NOT COVERED: plies other than 25 and the Opera Game; a line the rule accepts that a strong player would call silly (the rule asks legality, forcing plies and the sentence shape, not chess judgement).

breaks.name: quiet-ply-kept
breaks.why: the trim keeps a quiet ply inside the line, so Bxe7 a6 Bxd7 is shown as a line the opponent has no reason to follow

breaks.name: line-cut-to-one-ply
breaks.why: the line is always one ply, so the recovery Kunal asked to see is never on screen

breaks.name: line-may-end-on-the-opponent
breaks.why: the trim stops at any forcing ply, so a line can end on the opponent's move
